messages:
alex: noticing a p99 latency spike on prod-gateway since 15:04 UTC, ~3x baseline. traces point to connection churn after the connpool tuning merge. I opened a rollback PR to revert that commit.
maya: link?
alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4987 — rollback of connpool tuning
sam: @jin can you take a quick look? this is affecting canary -> prod traffic, want to be careful. :eyes:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026 created: prod-gateway latency spike — assigned to oncall
jin: pulling up the PR now. what quick canary steps do we want if we merge?
alex: canary plan in PR description. for oncall: deploy to 2 pods, watch p95/p99 and 5xx rate for 10m, then 10% traffic for 15m, then full. commands:
```
# rollout to canary
kubectl apply -f k8s/prod-gateway/canary-2pods.yaml --namespace=prod
# check pods
watch -n 5 kubectl get pods -l app=prod-gateway
# quick health metrics
curl -sS https://prod-gateway.internal/metrics | grep -E "p95|p99|5xx|connpool"
```
maya: also reduce batching to 8 tokens on the canary to mitigate burst token pressure — add ENV override in canary yaml
sam: skimmed PR, looks straightforward. small nit on the revert script (rm -f stray tmp file) but not blocking. @jin your +1 needed to merge
jin: left a tiny inline comment about log level toggle, but i'm okay to approve for rollback. approving now, will watch post-merge.
alex: merging in ~30s. will only roll out canary first. tagging oncall in the merge message.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: infra/rollback-4987 by alex — canary (2 pods)
sam: placing a 15m alert suppress for the incident so we don't flurry on the alert noise while we watch
maya: noted. also starting a remote load test script against canary to simulate traffic pattern:
```
python tools/loadgen.py --target prod-gateway-canary --rps 200 --duration 600
```
jin: can see canary pods coming up, ready=1/1 on both. metrics showing p99 dropping already ~45%. monitoring dashboards now.
alex: merge complete and canary traffic routed. leaving the rollback PR linked in incident.
ops-bot: Deploy success: infra/rollback-4987 — canary rollout complete
sam: p95/p99 and 5xx trending back to baseline. holding 15m watch. if stable, roll to 10% then full.
jin: thanks team — will post a short follow-up in #postmortems with timeline and quick remedial items.
maya: opening a follow-up PR to add a regression test for connpool churn and a perf-run in CI
alex: great. big thanks, everyone. closing incident once full rollout completes and metrics are stable. :thumbsup:
messages_brief: alex: noticing a p99 latency spike..., maya: link?, alex: PR link, sam: @jin pls review, ops-bot: Incident created, jin: pulling up PR, alex: canary plan + commands, maya: reduce batching, sam: small nit, jin: approve, alex: merging, deploy-bot: deploy triggered, sam: suppress alerts, maya: load test, jin: canary healthy metrics improving, alex: merge complete, ops-bot: deploy success, sam: monitoring, jin: will post follow-up, maya: follow-up PR, alex: thanks
